items.title: Agent Skills 落地实战：拒绝“裸奔”，构建确定性与灵活性共存的混合架构
items.raw_excerpt: 随着 Anthropic 开源 skills 仓库，"Code Interpreter"（代码解释器）模式成为 Agent 开发的热门方向。许多开发者试图采取激进路线：赋予 LLM 联网和 Python 执行权限，让其现场编写代码来解决一切问题。但在构建企业级“智能文档分析 Agent”的实践中，我们发现这种“全托管”模式在稳定性、安全性和可控性上存在巨大隐患。本文将分享我们如何摒弃激进路线，采用 Java (确定性 ETL) + DSL 封装式 Skills + 实时渲染 的混合架构，在保留 LLM 灵活性的同时，确保系统的工业级稳定性。

title_i18n.zh: Agent Skills 落地实战：拒绝“裸奔”，构建确定性与灵活性共存的混合架构
title_i18n.en: Agent Skills Implementation in Practice: Rejecting "Naked Deployment," Building a Hybrid Architecture that Balances Determinism and Flexibility.
title_i18n.es: Habilidades del Agente en la Práctica: Rechazar la "Exposición Total", Construir una Arquitectura Híbrida que Combina Determinismo y Flexibilidad

excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着 Anthropic 开源 skills 仓库，"Code Interpreter"（代码解释器）模式成为 Agent 开发的热门方向。许多开发者试图采取激进路线：赋予 LLM 联网和 Python 执行权限，让其现场编写代码来解决一切问题。但在构建企业级“智能文档分析 Agent”的实践中，我们发现这种“全托管”模式在稳定性、安全性和可控性上存在巨大隐患。本文将分享我们如何摒弃激进路线，采用 Java (确定性 ETL) + DSL 封装式 Skills + 实时渲染 的混合架构，在保留 LLM 灵活性的同时，确保系统的工业级稳定性。
excerpt_i18n.en: With Anthropic's open-sourcing of the skills repository, the "Code Interpreter" mode has become a popular direction in Agent development. Many developers have attempted to take a radical approach: granting LLMs internet access and Python execution permissions to write code on the fly to solve all problems. However, in the practice of building an enterprise-level "Intelligent Document Analysis Agent," we found that this "fully managed" model poses significant risks in terms of stability, security, and controllability. This article shares how we abandoned the radical approach and adopted a hybrid architecture of Java (deterministic ETL) + DSL-encapsulated Skills + real-time rendering, preserving the flexibility of LLMs while ensuring industrial-grade system stability.
excerpt_i18n.es: Con la apertura del repositorio de skills de Anthropic, el modo "Code Interpreter" se ha convertido en una dirección popular en el desarrollo de Agent. Muchos desarrolladores intentan adoptar un enfoque radical: otorgar a LLM permisos de acceso a internet y ejecución de Python, permitiéndole escribir código en tiempo real para resolver cualquier problema. Sin embargo, en la práctica de construir un "Agente de análisis de documentos inteligentes" a nivel empresarial, hemos descubierto que este modo de "gestión total" presenta grandes riesgos en términos de estabilidad, seguridad y controlabilidad. Este artículo compartirá cómo hemos abandonado el enfoque radical y adoptado Java (ETL determinista) + DS.

items.title: A Spectrum Album – Structuring AI-Generated Music with Suno
items.raw_excerpt: Kar Beyaz Tüm Renkler is a spectrum album: a single musical idea observed through multiple forms. Each track starts from the same core motif and applies controlled stylistic transformations, producing distinct yet related pieces. Conceptually, this treats the music as one latent musical structure projected into different musical domains. A spectrum album is a general compositional approach: a way of exploring how one theme can remain itself while producing many realizations. Kar Beyaz Tüm Renkler is its first application. The workflow uses structured prompting in Suno for generation, followed by external loudness normalization and AI mastering for consistency across tracks.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On January 19, 2026, Anker Innovations and Feishu jointly launched the latest AI hardware—the Anker AI Recording Pod, with Feishu providing the software AI adaptation and services for the product. This device features an extremely lightweight magnetic button design for unobtrusive wearable use. Leveraging Feishu's AI capabilities, it supports voiceprint recognition, real-time transcription and translation, real-time AI visual summaries, and smart meeting minutes generation. Combined with Feishu's knowledge Q&A, it transforms recordings into collaborative and transferable knowledge assets.

The AI Recording Pod has a diameter of 23.2 millimeters, comparable to the size of a coin, and weighs only 10 grams. In this form factor, users can carry it as a lapel clip or pendant, making it more portable than traditional voice recorders or recording cards and suitable for a wider range of scenarios. The device is equipped with two omnidirectional microphones with an effective recording radius of 5 meters. Paired with intelligent noise reduction algorithms, it accurately filters background noise even in noisy environments, delivering clear voice reproduction. In terms of battery life, it supports 8 hours of continuous recording, and with the charging case, the total recording time extends to 32 hours, meeting all-day recording needs.

With Feishu's AI adaptation and services, this product will further support real-time speaker voiceprint recognition, multilingual transcription, real-time AI visual summaries, and generate multimodal AI meeting minutes with images and text after meetings. Recording content and AI-generated minutes can be automatically saved as personal assets in Feishu.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de enero de 2026, Anker Innovations y Feishu lanzaron conjuntamente el último hardware de IA: Anker AI Recording Bean, con Feishu proporcionando la adaptación de software de IA y servicios para este producto. Este dispositivo, con una forma extremadamente ligera de "botón magnético", permite un uso discreto y portátil. Basado en las capacidades de IA de Feishu, admite reconocimiento de voz, transcripción y traducción en tiempo real, resumen visual de IA en tiempo real y generación inteligente de actas. Combinado con el sistema de preguntas y respuestas de conocimiento de Feishu, convierte las grabaciones en activos de conocimiento colaborativos y transferibles. El AI Recording Bean tiene un diámetro de 23,2 milímetros, similar al tamaño de una moneda.

excerpt_i18n.en: On January 19, ByteDance's AI Agent platform "Kouzi" announced its 2.0 brand upgrade. Launched in February 2024, Kouzi was initially positioned as a new-generation AI Agent platform. Based on experience serving over 10 million real-world development scenarios, Kouzi 2.0 has undergone a comprehensive redesign, with its positioning and mission now focused on assisting more professionals. Kouzi 2.0 integrates Agent Skill, Agent Plan, Agent Coding, and Agent Office capabilities, enabling AI to truly become users' "work partners." Agent Skills: Equipping with industry skill packages to make general AI more professional. General Agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in handling basic tasks, showing significant progress in daily conversations, information integration, and simple reasoning. However, to tackle complex scenarios requiring high specialization, precision, or controllability, enhancements with specific skills are still necessary. excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de enero, la plataforma de AI Agent "Kouzi" de ByteDance anunció una actualización de marca a la versión 2.0. Kouzi se lanzó en febrero de 2024, inicialmente posicionado como una plataforma de nueva generación para AI Agent. Basándose en la experiencia de servir más de 10 millones de escenarios de desarrollo reales, Kouzi 2.0 ha sido completamente reconstruido, con el objetivo y misión de ayudar a más profesionales en el entorno laboral. Kouzi 2.0 integra capacidades como Agent Skill, Agent Plan, Agent Coding y Agent Office, haciendo que la IA se convierta en un verdadero "compañero de trabajo" para los usuarios.
